# Native Reasonix commit stores

Generated by Reasonix's own `internal/session.encodeV4Commits`, `Manifest`,
`Commit`, `Event`, `provider.Message` and `sessioncontent.Store` from source
commit `4a050542060ae15cd3d16ba2a10dbeee0f2c8722`. The source producer was run
in an isolated worktree with synthetic, public input; no user history,
credentials or running Reasonix processes were involved. This is codec producer
coverage, not a claim that every full frontend was driven interactively.

The four producer codecs are linear/v3, linear/v3.1, events/v3 and linear/v4.
Desktop `desktop-sessions-v5/by-id` uses the same linear/v4 framed codec.
The tool-result payload exceeds the producer's 64 KiB inline threshold, so
its v4 representation references the real content-addressed object alongside
these captures. The JSONL encodings contain the same full message payload.

Tests copy stores into all supported layouts and exercise discovery, summary,
transcript, cold cache, atomic/torn-tail append, upsert and retract. Additional
mutation tests exercise integrity rejection and provider-context changes.
